fields.name: title
fields.label: Panel Title
fields.description: The question shown in the accordion trigger row (required, max 256 characters)

validation.customErrorMsg: Panel title is required, must not start with a space, and cannot exceed 256 characters

fields.name: content
fields.label: Panel Content
fields.description: The answer content revealed when the panel is expanded

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Theme
fields.description: Choose the colour scheme for the cards section

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Product/category icon displayed at 24×24px inside a 48×48px tinted container

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Comma-separated badge labels shown below the icon (e.g. Popular, No Fees). Optional.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Card heading. Maximum 60 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Title is required and must be 60 characters or fewer

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Highlighted callout in gold (e.g. rate or fee). Optional. Maximum 60 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Subtitle must be 60 characters or fewer

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Supporting body copy. Maximum 120 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Description is required and must be 120 characters or fewer

fields.name: cta-primary-label
fields.label: Primary CTA Label
fields.description: Label for the primary button. Maximum 40 characters.

fields.name: cta-primary-url
fields.label: Primary CTA URL
fields.description: Destination URL for the primary button

fields.name: cta-secondary-label
fields.label: Secondary CTA Label
fields.description: Optional: label for the secondary outline button. Leave blank to hide. Maximum 40 characters.

validation.customErrorMsg: Secondary CTA label must be 40 characters or fewer

fields.name: cta-secondary-url
fields.label: Secondary CTA URL
fields.description: Destination URL for the secondary outline button. Only used when Secondary CTA Label is provided.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Choose light or dark colour scheme for the page background and navigation controls.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Slide heading — displayed as an h2 (max 60 characters).

validation.customErrorMsg: Title is required and must be between 1 and 60 characters

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional sub-heading displayed below the title (max 80 characters).

fields.name: link
fields.label: CTA Link
fields.description: Optional call-to-action link. The link text is used as the button label.

fields.name: background-image
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Optional background image (cover crop). When set, overrides the background colour field.

fields.name: background-color
fields.label: Background Colour
fields.description: Optional CSS colour (e.g. #002855) or gradient (e.g. linear-gradient(90deg, #002855, #003D7A)). Ignored when a background image is set. Leave blank to use the default brand palette by slide index.
